messages:
nora: FYI auditor Claire asked for a compact deliverable showing the recent RBAC narrowing for service-account-embed-prod and the corresponding KMS decrypts for 2025-09-07. They want: 1) approval evidence, 2) signed KMS export with checksum, 3) a 1-page control map (SOC2/ISO). Need by EOD.
samuel_sec: Approval is in JIRA SEC-3098, reviewer attestation in doc sec-reviews/2025-09-06-embed-sa.md. PR is infra/iam#1450, commit b12d9e. I'll link and pull the checklist summary.
dev-anya: Deploy was a gitops apply by gitops-bot at 2025-09-07T09:42:13Z. Kube audit shows RoleBinding update and I have the snippet. I'll sanitize and include the snippet and the CI link. Snippet: ```json
{"verb":"update","objectRef":{"resource":"rolebinding","name":"embed-prod-bind"},"user":"gitops-bot@redwood"}
```
secbot: evidence-bundle: starting job ev-20250907-005; collecting: jira/SEC-3098, commit/b12d9e, kube-audit-snippet, kms-export. Progress: 0/4.
auditor_claire: Quick Qs: a) We need the KMS decrypts exported as machine-readable JSON + sha256 and a detached GPG signature. b) Provide a short chain-of-custody: who exported, when, and where stored. c) Map artifacts to SOC2 CC-3.2, CC-6.1 and ISO A.9.4.
ops-ryan: I'll run the export for 2025-09-07 09:00-10:00 UTC and sign with ops@redwood.com. Command: ```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" AND timestamp>="2025-09-07T09:00:00Z" AND timestamp<="2025-09-07T10:00:00Z"' --format=json > /tmp/kms-20250907.json
sha256sum /tmp/kms-20250907.json > /tmp/kms-20250907.json.sha256
gpg --local-user ops@redwood.com --output /tmp/kms-20250907.json.sig --detach-sign /tmp/kms-20250907.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250907.json s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-09-07/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250907.json.sig s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-09-07/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250907.json.sha256 s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-09-07/
```
samuel_sec: Least-privilege checklist excerpt: removed broad role roles/editor from embed-prod SA; replaced with custom role redwood.kmsDecryptOnly (kms.decrypt, logging.logViewer). Assessment matrix attached in the runbook.
secbot: evidence-bundle: progress 2/4 (jira/SEC-3098, commit/b12d9e added).
auditor_claire: Also confirm retention and immutability: logs should be retained 395 days and evidence bucket snapshots enforce WORM for 7 days. We record notary timestamps for hashes.
ops-ryan: Confirmed: logs-retention-policy-v2 = 395 days. Uploaded signed export: s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-09-07/kms-20250907.json (sig + sha256). SHA256: 3ac674216f3e15c761ee1a5e255f0679d1b3a3d4d0a3c3f4b5d1e2f3a4b5c6d7. Notarized via internal notary NT-20250907-21.
deva-anya: Kube audit excerpt shows the RoleBinding change at 09:42:13 and subsequent CI rollout at 09:43:01. I'll add a 2-line timeline to the one-pager.
secbot: evidence-bundle: completed. job ev-20250907-005 status=success artifacts=4
auditor_claire: Perfect 2 please send presigned link + the one-page control map and the signed export. Auditor may ask for 3 sample raw lines to verify sha256.
nora: Sending now. Thanks team for the quick turn. :white_check_mark:
